notes.title: Backyard Baseball '01 Update Alert
notes.content:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45246326/3da7ca12c363cbd06b3b3f4753eabea156caf24b.png"][/img]Hi-ho Baseball Fans!
 
Patch 1.0.8 has arrived and is jam packed with improvements we've made since launch. 
Here's the breakdown of all the improvements to the game:
[/p][h3]Stability and Performance Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the Out of Array pointers crash[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed instances of stats corruption after playing multiple games[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the crash that occurs when relaunching a save in the middle of an extra inning[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where options are not being retained in the sound settings when relaunching the game[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixed Visual Bugs[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a UI visual glitch in batting practice that occurs on the third strike.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug in the Hall of Fame screen that's displaying the incorrect team color.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the visual bug in the statistics page that was showing unreliable data.[/p][/*][*][p]Realigned the #5 to other characters used when creating a new coach.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the visual bug where the field that’s being selected in batting practice isn’t consistent with the one being presented in-game.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Audio Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the background sound to restart in the appropriate screens[/p][/*][/list][p][b][i][u]NOTE: We also want to inform players that updating to this version will revert progress back to their last completed game.[/u][/i][/b] 

If you run into any further bugs after this patch, please keep sending them our way through the following options:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSctyd1Ul50QCB3Xhyi62CymYqgzs-JefiGIypeHUt_hYAbt9Q/viewform"]Bug Report Form[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Support Email: [/b][url="https://Support@megacatstudios.com"]Support@megacatstudios.com[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/megacat"]Join us on Discord[/url]


[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed the Out of Array pointers crash
Fixed instances of stats corruption after playing multiple games
Fixed the crash that occurs when relaunching a save in the middle of an extra inning
Fixed the issue where options are not being retained in the sound settings when relaunching the game
Fixed a UI visual glitch in batting practice that occurs on the third strike.
Fixed a visual bug in the Hall of Fame screen that's displaying the incorrect team color.
Fixed the visual bug in the statistics page that was showing unreliable data.
Realigned the #5 to other characters used when creating a new coach.
Fixed the visual bug where the field that’s being selected in batting practice isn’t consistent with the one being presented in-game.

notes.title: Backyard Baseball '01 Patch Update Alert
notes.content: [h1]Update 1.0.0 - 1.0.3[/h1][p]Hi-ho Baseball Fans![/p][p]Your Day 1 Patch notes compilation has finally arrived, and we're here to give you a breakdown of all the little improvements we made to the game today.[/p][p][b]Patches 1.0.0-1.0.3[/b] include the following fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Expand Screen function was force-disabled on launch[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed a legacy DirectX check issue that causes periodic device-specific crashes[/p][/*][*][p]Update to the intro cinematic[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed memory management issues causing heap exhaustion[/p][/*][/list][p]Restoring this game to its former glory can be a bumpy process, but we're committed to making your experience the best it can be and really appreciate your help and feedback along the way.[/p][p]If you run into any further bugs after this patch, please keep sending them our way through the following options:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://bit.ly/BYB01BRF"]Bug Report Form[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Support Email: [/b][url="https://support@megacatstudios.com"]support@megacatstudios.com[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/megacat"]Join us on Discord[/url][/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where the Expand Screen function was force-disabled on launch
- Addressed a legacy DirectX check issue that causes periodic device-specific crashes
- Fixed memory management issues causing heap exhaustion
